Tested out the Canoe motor mount I whipped up. Went into a little lake that's never fished.

Hit up a small lake, that was previously unaccessable because the only access was privately owned and used as a driving range where assholes got drunk and shot golf balls at the lake. That's shut down and abandoned now so people can get in. I've never seen anyone else fish it though. Lots of pike, didn't get any walleye for a change. Poked around with my fish finder the lakes only 10' deep lots of weed beds and a rocky island in the middle. Finder shows lots of fish. I have a feeling I know where the walleye are hiding for next time.

Motor mount worked perfectly nice and stable, plenty of room for my battery and all our gear.

Also the pictures aren't as clear as usual because my phone was in its waterproof case and I had fish slime fingers.
